source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4, Theorem 4.1 and immediately following paragraph (journal pp. 999–1034).

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Machine Learning Research 25 (2024), paper 279
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper analyzes one-correct-nuisance drift and regularity for partially linear regression using its own auxiliary nuisances, and states that ordinary doubly robust estimators are generally not asymptotically linear under a single correct nuisance without additional structure.
The preprint develops cross-fitting and doubly cross-fitted doubly robust estimators with product-form remainder control for average linear functionals.
The paper characterizes factorization through nonnegative toric varieties, feasible support, and toric-ideal equations; it does not treat DATE loading kernels or ordered adoption supports.
